texts.zh: 围绕着[Root.GetName]的轨道空间到处都是曾经居住在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]遗留的残骸，他们在文明被毁灭之前向太空射出了数千个原始的卫星和飞弹发射平台。许多都在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]可怕的使用核武的战争中被反卫星武器摧毁了，这样一来太空垃圾就更多了。我们在地表的殖民者认为这些残骸已经影响了基础设施的运作，因为这些残骸，我们只能在有限的条件下使用卫星和轨道飞行的技术。
texts.en:
The orbital space around [Root.GetName] is cluttered with debris left behind by the alien civilization that once inhabited the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Before they wiped themselves out, their early space programs saw the launch of thousands of primitive satellites and missile launch platforms. Many of these were destroyed by anti-satellite weapons during the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s destructive nuclear war, adding even more space junk to the mix.

Our colony on the surface has developed to a point where this dense field of debris is interfering with its infrastructure. We cannot use satellites and civilian orbital flights are limited to narrow launch windows.

texts.zh: 环绕[Root.GetName]周围的轨道空间中充满了杂乱无章的碎片，严重影响到了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上殖民地的发展，扫描并绘制碎片区域地图需要科技船上装载的强大传感器。
texts.en: The orbital space around [Root.GetName] is cluttered with debris that is interfering with the development of the colony on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Mapping the extensive debris field will require the powerful sensors of a Science Ship.

texts.zh: 在科研船的帮助下，[Root.GetName]殖民地终于成功地清理了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道空间，现在卫星和轨道飞行都变得安全了。
texts.en: With the assistance of our Science Ship, colonial authorities on [From.From.GetName] have finished cleaning up the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s orbital space. It has now been made safe for satellites and civilian travel.

texts.zh: 在科研船的帮助下，[Root.GetName]殖民地终于成功地清理了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道空间，现在卫星和轨道飞行都变得安全了。我们发现[Root.GetPlanetMoon]残骸中包含着许多价值极高的矿产，我们成功地回收了许多矿产，使得这次行动获利颇丰。
texts.en:
With the assistance of our Science Ship, colonial authorities on [From.From.GetName] have finished cleaning up the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s orbital space. It has now been made safe for satellites and civilian travel.

As it turns out, a lot of the debris consisted of valuable minerals from the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface that had been used in satellite construction. We were able to salvage a significant amount, netting a tidy profit in the process.

texts.zh: 一艘民用货船在登陆[Root.GetName]的途中被一群轨道中快速移动的残骸击中了，船员没有幸存者，飞船的残骸击中了一个殖民地的主能源继电器，爆炸导致了大量平民伤亡，一些基础设施遭受重创。
texts.en: A civilian freighter coming in to land on [Root.GetName] was perforated by a dense cloud of fast-moving orbital debris! The flight crew was killed immediately, and the stricken craft tumbled through the atmosphere only to crash-land near one of the colony's main power relays. The resulting explosion resulted in several deaths on the ground, and local infrastructure suffered considerable damage.

texts.zh: 一艘准备在[Root.GetName]着陆的工人单位货船被一团高速移动的密集轨道残骸击穿了！飞行员单位瞬间被摧毁，而被击中的飞船翻滚着穿过大气层，砸到了殖民地的一个主继电站附近。随之而来的爆炸导致数个地面单位行动终止，而且当地基础设施也受到了较大的损伤。
texts.en: A worker unit freighter coming in to land on [Root.GetName] was perforated by a dense cloud of fast-moving orbital debris! The flight crew units were destroyed instantly, and the stricken craft tumbled through the atmosphere only to crash-land near one of the colony's main power relays. The resulting explosion resulted in several operation terminations on the ground, and local infrastructure suffered considerable damage.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]轨道中一片密集的残骸将空间轨道变成了一个垃圾场。这片残骸——我们相信是在之前[Root.GetPlanetMoon]使用核武的战争使用的飞弹发射平台——被引力拉入了大气层，对我们的一个主要居住站造成了巨大的影响，目前得到的初步报告中显示这可能会造成重大伤亡。
texts.en: A cascade of collisions in the dense layer of debris surrounding [Root.GetName] recently shifted the orbit of a large piece of space junk. The object - which we believe was one of the many orbital missile platforms used in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s nuclear war - was pulled into the atmosphere, and unfortunately proceeded to impact directly on top of a major settlement. Initial reports indicate heavy casualties.

label.zh: 我们需要处理一下这些残骸
label.en: We really need to do something about that debris.

summary.text:
# 轨道残骸 / Orbital Debris

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/colony_events_1.txt:4011-4230`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 核爆废土殖民地的随机事件（75/958、50/739）；每个帝国一次（had_colony_170）。
  Random colony event on a nuked wasteland colony (75/958, 50/739); once per empire (had_colony_170).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 170「轨道碎片」：启用清理项目，同时安排 171「货船坠毁」与 172「碎片撞击」（200天+随机7000天，需碎片修正仍在）。
  170 "Orbital Debris": enables the clean-up project and schedules 171 "Freighter Crash" and 172 "Debris Impact" (200 days + random 7000, needing the debris modifier).
- 项目完成 → 173 或 174（各50%），移除碎片修正。
  Project done -> 173 or 174 (50% each), removing the debris modifier.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 清理项目与延迟事件是竞赛：碎片被清除后 171/172 不再满足条件。
  The project races the delayed events: once cleaned, 171/172 no longer qualify.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 机械帝国看到不同措辞的171。
  Machine empires see different wording at 171.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、延迟、修正条件、项目结果。
  Checked: trigger, delays, modifier conditions, project outcomes.
